Resources are exclusive: api uses api:board, file:board.mjs, product:reminder-visibility; ui uses file:board.html — no conflict. Capacity 2 and dispatchBudget 2 are fully utilized. Database remains blocked by migration-lock (blocker: migration-lock). Integration is pending, awaiting next cycle. QA depends on api, database, ui, and integration; therefore QA cannot proceed until the database task completes (not merely becomes unblocked). Next dependency-aware steps: after api and ui complete, dispatch integration; once integration completes AND database completes (migration-lock cleared and database work finished), dispatch qa, then review, then release. CI status unknown.
